papers.title_en: NI-ACT: A Neural Intent Interface for Brain-Embodied Manipulation
papers.authors: Yinghao Li, WeiHsien Lee, Zeyu Zhang, Canyang Zhao, Ke Fang, Xing Li, Bing Liu
papers.evidence: 以神经意图条件化具身策略，通过视觉与本体感觉完成目标抓取
papers.tldr: 侵入式脑机接口通常要求用户持续用神经活动控制接近、修正和抓取，任务负担较重；神经群体活动能否直接表达任务级目标并交由具身策略执行，仍不明确。NI-ACT将短暂运动皮层信号作为持久意图令牌，仅读取一次，再由视觉与本体感觉驱动闭环操作策略。在目标无法由场景判断的测试中，群体潜变量令牌使抓取率达81%，高于单热方向的69%；信号来源与读取时机也影响表现。PMd运动前准备活动足以指导完整抓取，表明神经意图的表示、脑区和时刻共同决定具身操控效果，为更自然的脑控机器人提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Intracortical brain-computer interfaces can drive robotic arms, but they keep the user inside the fast sensorimotor loop: every approach, correction, and grasp must be neurally specified. Whether intracortical population activity can instead serve as a task-level condition for a learned embodied policy, without symbolic commands or hand-designed skill libraries, remains unknown. NI-ACT addresses this question with a hierarchical brain-embodied framework: a brief motor-cortical signal is read once as a persistent intent, and a visuomotor policy then closes the perception-action loop from vision and proprioception. In a counterfactual grasping task where the scene cannot specify the target, the neural intent alone determined which object the robot grasped; replacing the intent changed the behavior accordingly. Passing the full population latent as a dedicated intent token, rather than a one-hot decoded direction, raised grasp completion from 69% to 81% over 132 held-out scenes, whereas a continuous direction alone did not improve on a one-hot label. Where the signal was read also mattered: in one dual-array session, with the readout window matched, premotor (PMd) intent completed more grasps than primary motor (M1) intent (77% vs. 53%), and the conventional post-cue M1 readout reached 42%. Preparatory activity was itself sufficient: in a center-out task, intent read only from PMd before the go cue (that is, before any movement) drove complete grasps, and in one recording it completed more grasps than the same animal's post-cue readout. These results show that how a neural signal is represented, and where and when it is read, jointly determine how effectively it conveys movement goals to an embodied agent.

papers.title_en: Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Nhat-Quynh Le-Pham, Khoi Nguyen, Binh-Son Hua
papers.evidence: 高斯泼溅场景中的开放词汇三维实例分割
papers.tldr: 开放词汇三维理解希望按文本定位任意物体，但现有高斯泼溅方法往往依赖昂贵预处理与漫长训练，难以快速部署。本文提出无需训练的查询式分割框架，以稠密像素级 CLIP 特征保留细粒度语义，不依赖预定义实例候选。系统在精选枢轴视图中定位目标，借助视频分割器跨视图传播，再以可见性投票将二维轨迹映射到三维高斯，生成边界清晰的实例掩码。实验在 LERF-OVS、ScanNet 和 ScanNet++ 上达到最先进表现，在 3D-OVS 上具竞争力，且相比既有方法显著提速，展示了高效开放词汇三维理解的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. Given a text query, we identify a high-quality target region in a carefully selected pivot view and propagate it across views using a video segmentor, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the target instance. We then lift the resulting 2D tracklets to 3D Gaussians through a novel visibility voting strategy, yielding accurate 3D segmentation masks with clean object boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on LERF-OVS, ScanNet, and ScanNet++, competitive results on 3D-OVS, and significant speedups over existing open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of our framework for efficient open-vocabulary 3D understanding without per-scene training.

papers.title_en: JEPA4R: Embodied JEPA World Models with 4D Point Planning
papers.authors: Jiarui Dong, Zhiheng Liang, Yanjun Li, Zeyu Zhang, Heejeong Nam, Haoyu Chen, Hao Tang
papers.evidence: 基于深度点云预测未来状态并在潜在空间规划机器人行动
papers.tldr: 操纵任务需要准确的度量几何，但基于图像的世界模型常将几何与外观纠缠，潜在预测也难以直观检验。JEPA4R以单台深度相机获取的点云为输入，在潜空间预测未来并规划动作，再由策略头控制机器人；解码器还能展示模型想象的未来四维点云。其200步预测平均点误差低于1.1厘米，在多项仿真基准领先像素模型，且数字孪生训练的策略可零样本迁移到真实机械臂。该工作把可视化的几何预测、长时规划与真实操控连接起来，为具身世界模型的评估和应用提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models predict future embeddings instead of pixels and plan in latent space. Two challenges remain: 2D images leave the metric geometry that manipulation acts on implicit and entangled with appearance, and what these models imagine stays hidden, as they are mostly judged in simulation by short-horizon latent planning. We present JEPA4R, a JEPA world model that observes single-depth-camera point clouds, predicts and plans in their latent space, and acts through a policy head on its frozen latents; we call this 4D point planning. A decoder on the frozen world model shows what it imagines as 4D point clouds, with a mean point error within 1.1 cm over 200 steps. Under the policy-learning protocols of OGBench and CortexBench, JEPA4R leads pixel JEPA models on OGBench Cube-Single, Cube-Double, Cube-Triple and Scene, and ranks first on MetaWorld and Adroit Relocate with 98.4% and 88.0%, above the runner-up, R3M, at 96.0% and 65.3%. Trained only in a digital twin, JEPA4R and its policy heads run zero-shot on the real arm with both a gripper and a dexterous hand.

papers.title_en: SemLite-GS: Semantic-Selective Parallel Gaussian Splatting for Lightweight Building Reconstruction from UAV Oblique Imagery
papers.authors: Tengfei Wang, Xin Wang, Zihan Li, Quanjian Ji, Yifei Yu, Dong Lin, Zongqian Zhan
papers.evidence: 从无人机斜视影像进行三维建筑重建并生成网格
papers.tldr: 大规模无人机倾斜影像可用于城市建筑建模，但传统流程通常要进行密集场景重建、建筑提取和网格简化，计算开销较大。SemLite-GS先借助正射参考图统一建筑身份，再将身份传播到倾斜影像中，构建相机与建筑实例配对，并对目标区域开展语义选择式并行高斯训练。随后利用渲染深度、不透明度和法线提取建筑平面，指导网格优化及自适应面数分配。多组数据实验表明，该方法显著缩短重建时间，并在相近面数预算下更好保留主体平面和清晰建筑边界。
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight 3D building models support urban spatial analysis, but their production often requires dense scene reconstruction, building extraction, and mesh simplification. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is more efficient than conventional multi-view stereo, existing large-scale methods lack semantic selection and parallel instance-level training. We present SemLite-GS, a building-centric framework that reconstructs lightweight building meshes from large-scale UAV oblique imagery. First, an orthographic reference map establishes globally consistent building identities, which are propagated to oblique views to form camera-instance pairs and regions of interest. Second, semantic-selective parallel PGSR training jointly processes multiple pairs within relevant image regions while updating only target Gaussians; contextual Gaussians remain fixed to preserve visibility. Third, architectural planes extracted from rendered depth, opacity, and normal maps guide signed distance field optimization, producing meshes with adaptive polygon allocation and well-defined structural boundaries. Experiments on multiple large-scale UAV datasets demonstrate that our SemLite-GS substantially reduces building reconstruction time compared with representative full-scene 3DGS methods. With comparable polygon budgets, SemLite-GS achieves superior preservation of dominant planar structures and sharp architectural transitions compared with conventional dense reconstruction followed by mesh decimation. The source code is available at https://github.com/IRIS-LAB-whu/SemLite-GS.

papers.title_en: EasyNav: A Modular Architecture for Real-Time Navigation Across Heterogeneous Robot Environments
papers.authors: Francisco Martín Rico, Francisco Miguel Moreno, Juan Sebastián Cely Gutiérrez, Esther Aguado, Miguel Ángel De Miguel Paraíso, José Miguel Guerrero
papers.evidence: 机器人导航架构覆盖定位、规划、控制与环境移动
papers.tldr: 机器人导航栈常将建图、定位、规划与控制绑定于特定表示和数据流，在多传感器、多坐标系及异步更新环境中难扩展、难比较，也难保证端到端时序。EasyNav以显式共享导航状态作为模块间唯一交互接口，并用兼容性与时序契约约束各模块，实现可替换、表示无关的导航流程。该开源ROS 2框架在真实机器人室内激光导航及GPS与3D激光雷达跨室内外多层路线中验证；匹配条件下相较Nav2，反应延迟室内由377降至33毫秒、室外由71降至8毫秒，且CPU和内存占用更低。研究表明，共享状态与明确契约有助于异构环境下构建实时、可扩展且便于评测的导航系统。
papers.abstract_en: Most robot navigation stacks implicitly bind mapping, localization, planning, and control to specific representations and data flows, yielding architectures hard to extend, compare experimentally, or reason about end-to-end timing. This is critical in heterogeneous scenarios, where multiple spatial representations, sensing modalities, and coordinate frames coexist and evolve at different rates. This paper presents a navigation architecture centered on an explicit, shared navigation state that serves as the sole interaction interface between modular components. Constraining mapping, localization, planning, and control to operate over this shared state enables interchangeable, representation-agnostic pipelines under explicit compatibility and timing contracts. We realize this architecture as EasyNav, an open source ROS 2 framework, and validate it through real-robot experiments, including indoor navigation with laser sensing and large-scale indoor-outdoor navigation with GPS and 3D LiDAR across multi-level routes. Compared with Nav2 under matched conditions, EasyNav reduces reaction latency from 377 to 33 ms indoors and from 71 to 8 ms outdoors, while also using less CPU and memory.

papers.title_en: DexFormer 2.0: Towards a Cross-Embodiment Foundation Policy for Dexterous Grasping
papers.authors: Lixin Xu, Ke Zhang, Xinyu Liu, Jie Tan, Senming Tan, Jiaju Yin, Yating Feng, Xiaoyi Lin, Xiyue Dong, Renjing Xu
papers.evidence: 面向不同机器人形态的灵巧抓取策略与物体操作直接相关
papers.tldr: 灵巧抓取策略往往绑定单一机械臂与手，新组合需重新训练；关节数量、布局和动力学差异又使统一观测与动作接口难以建立。DexFormer 2.0 将机器人映射到带有效性掩码的规范关节接口，以运动学树偏置注意力编码形态，并借助 Transformer-XL 记忆近期交互、推断具体动力学。模型在四种臂和六种手构成的18种组合上训练，已见组合稳定成功率达89%，六种未见组合达51%，并可零样本适配新手型与平行夹爪。结果表明，跨具身共享策略可覆盖不同臂手组合，降低为新机器人单独训练策略的需求。
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous grasping policies are usually trained for one arm paired with one hand. Every new pairing then needs its own policy, and the number of policies grows with every arm and hand added. We ask whether a single policy can control many arm-hand combinations and transfer to pairings and hands it has never seen. This is hard because robots differ in the number, layout, and dynamics of their joints, so their observations and actions share no common interface. We present DexFormer 2.0, a single reinforcement learning policy for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping. It maps every robot to a canonical joint interface with validity masks, encodes each joint's morphology with attention biased by the kinematic tree, and uses a Transformer-XL memory to infer embodiment-dependent dynamics from recent interaction. Trained on 18 combinations of four arms and six hands, it reaches 89% stable success on seen combinations and 51% on six held-out arm-hand pairs, outperforming GRU and DexFormer 1.0 baselines. Without fine-tuning, it also grasps with four new hand types and, through retargeting, with parallel grippers. Ablations show that memory, the kinematic-tree bias, and broader pairing coverage each matter for transfer. On a physical Flexiv arm, distilled students transfer zero-shot from simulation with two hands, including a held-out pair. Project website: https://davidlxu.github.io/dexformer2-web/.

papers.title_en: NF-VLA: A Normalizing-Flow Baseline for Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.authors: Ruichen Deng, Qinyu Zhao, Yong-Hyun Park, Mutian Tong, Liang Zheng, Jiatao Gu
papers.evidence: 学习视觉语言条件下的连续机器人操作动作
papers.tldr: 机器人视觉—语言—动作策略需要学习连续动作，并在操作任务中可靠执行；自回归归一化流可提供可计算的动作概率密度，但其结构设计与推理修正仍需验证。NF-VLA以高容量深层接收视觉、语言和本体感知条件，浅层共享可逆动作变换，并对高斯平滑动作块联合进行精确最大似然训练。推理时，模型利用自身学得的密度进行一次基于分数的修正，无需另训去噪器。仅用LIBERO训练，四个标准套件成功率为98.35%，同一检查点在LIBERO-Plus达72.6%；消融也显示深层条件化和分数修正均有帮助，说明该架构是有竞争力的控制基线。
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. Trained on LIBERO from a pretrained vision--language backbone without robot pretraining, NF-VLA achieves 98.35\% success across the four standard suites and 72.6\% on LIBERO-Plus using the same checkpoint without further fine-tuning. Ablations show that deep-only prefix conditioning and score-based refinement both improve closed-loop success. Together, these results establish carefully structured autoregressive flows as a competitive approach to VLA control, with one learned density supporting policy training, action generation, and refinement.

papers.title_en: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
papers.authors: Ravindran Vasoor Saravanan, Chittin Varunav Ravi, Madhumita Singh, Thirulok Sundar Mohan Rasu
papers.evidence: 机器人依据语言指令进行语义导航与环境探索
papers.tldr: 自然语言导航要求移动机器人在非结构化环境中理解目标描述，并将开放词汇视觉感知接入建图与路径规划，传统流程整合仍具挑战。本文构建基于 ROS2 的端到端系统，结合前沿探索、Grounding DINO 文本提示检测、深度三维定位与语义地图，并由 Nav2 执行目标导航。Gazebo 室内测试中，TurtleBot3 探索并检测到五个目标中的三个，且两条自然语言指令均成功完成，无需任务专属训练。该工作验证了开放词汇视觉语言模型与经典导航栈结合的可行性，同时揭示检测不确定性、深度定位误差和探索覆盖不足等限制，为轻量级部署提供系统实践依据。
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.

papers.title_en: Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments
papers.authors: Subhransu S. Bhattacharjee, Dylan Campbell, Rahul Shome
papers.evidence: 通过匹配图像矩估计相机位姿
papers.tldr: 盲透视n点问题要求从二维与三维点集估计相机位姿，但点间对应关系未知，逐点匹配因而困难。MomentPnP不依赖学习或已知对应关系，而是匹配两组点集的十四个置换不变图像矩，以此初始化位姿，再通过期望最大化细化位姿和对应权重。理论上，完整无噪观测下，四阶以内的矩对几乎所有含至少二十个点的点集可识别固定相机位姿。三项基准中，其旋转误差中位数比最佳学习基线低5至170倍，且外点可达内点数量；稠密扫描点集越大，定位精度越高。
papers.abstract_en: The blind perspective-$n$-point (PnP) problem is to estimate the pose of a calibrated camera from 2D and 3D point sets with unknown correspondences. We show that, for complete, noiseless observations, fourteen permutation-invariant image moments up to order four identify a fixed camera pose for almost every 3D point set containing at least twenty points. Our learning-free method, MomentPnP, matches these moments between the observed 2D points and the projected 3D points to initialize a camera pose without correspondences and refines the pose and correspondence weights using expectation--maximization. Across the test sets of three benchmarks, our method reduces median rotation error by $5$--$170\times$ relative to the best learned baseline, both with and without outliers. We recover accurate poses even with as many outliers as inliers. On dense ETH3D scans, pose accuracy improves as the point sets grow, even as individual correspondences become harder to resolve.

papers.title_en: FlowRow: Learning Navigation Behaviors in Agricultural Environments with Long-Horizon Goal-Conditioned Flow Matching Policies
papers.authors: Utkarsh Bajpai, Cédric Pradalier, Stéphanie Aravecchia
papers.evidence: 学习移动机器人在农田环境中执行长时程目标导航
papers.tldr: 果园、葡萄园等半结构化田间环境要求机器人完成行内行驶、转行、跳行及行间穿越，依赖预设田块几何的方案难以支持任意跨行。FlowRow将导航表述为目标驱动任务，依据机器人相对长程目标与深度观测，用流匹配生成多样的SE(2)局部路径。作者构建涵盖葡萄园、柠檬园和苹果园的900回合仿真基准RowNavBench；FlowRow成功率达87%，优于最强基线的44%。该工作提供基准、数据与代码计划，推动面向复杂农业导航的系统评估与通用学习。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous monitoring and intervention in semi-structured agricultural environments, such as orchards and vineyards, require mobile robots to navigate to locations across diverse field configurations. This entails performing navigation behaviors including in-row driving, row turning and skipping, and inter-row traversal. Recent learning-based approaches have enabled robust in-row navigation from onboard perception, but navigation across rows typically requires a priori knowledge of field geometry to specify and tune row-transition maneuvers, preventing arbitrary transitions between rows. We address this challenge by framing navigation in these environments as a goal-directed navigation task, where a long-horizon goal is expressed relative to the robot and a planner generates local paths based on the goal and the robot's perceptual observations. We present FlowRow, a flow-matching-based local planner which models the distribution of diverse agricultural navigation behaviors as $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ paths using the long-horizon goal and depth perception. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce RowNavBench, a navigation benchmark for semi-structured agricultural environments developed in Isaac Sim, comprising 900 episodes across grape vineyards, lemon orchards, and apple orchards with varying row lengths, row and plant spacings, plant positions, and weed growth. FlowRow achieves 87% success, compared to 44% for the strongest generative behavior cloning baseline retrained on the same demonstrations. We will release our benchmark, data, and code upon acceptance.

papers.title_en: GRAZE: Text-Free Grasp Synthesis for Unseen Objects from Human Gaze
papers.authors: Jeongho Lee, Boeun Kim, Hyung Jin Chang, Jungchan Cho, Sang-Il Choi
papers.evidence: 面向未见物体的注视引导机器人抓取生成
papers.tldr: 文本条件的人手—物体交互生成虽便于语义控制，却难以准确指定物体上要抓取的部位及接近方向，尤其面对未见物体时更明显。GRAZE改用人的注视作为控制信号，以几何感知注视编码将视线映射到物体表面线索，并通过交叉注意力引导扩散式Transformer生成抓取动作。新建的HOT3D-Grasp采用物体不相交划分；未见物体上，目标部位命中率为49.3%、抓取成功率为66.3%，均优于文本基线，且跨数据集迁移成功率达45.3%。结果表明，文本更擅长命名部位，而注视补足接近侧信息，二者结合可兼顾部位精度与方向控制。
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned hand-object interaction (HOI) generation provides intuitive semantic control, but language is an indirect way to specify where an interaction should occur on an object. Naming the part to grasp requires object-specific words, and naming the approach side requires a reference frame that a prompt lacks. We propose GRAZE (GRAsp from gaZE), which generates hand-object grasp motion from recorded gaze instead of object and part names. Its Geometry-Aware Gaze Encoding (GeoGaze) maps gaze rays to cues on object geometry, and cross-attention conditions a diffusion Transformer on these cues. We also introduce HOT3D-Grasp, a grasp-centered benchmark with object-disjoint folds built on HOT3D recordings. On unseen objects, GRAZE grasps the target part more often than the strongest text-conditioned baseline (49.3% vs. 43.6%), achieves the highest grasp success (66.3% vs. 46.6%), and transfers without fine-tuning to GazeHOI (45.3% vs. 33.8%). Gaze conveys the approach side: when gaze is rotated around the object, the approach turns with it in 59.1% of cases, against 20.5% for a text model retrained with clock words. On the same backbone, a text prompt names parts better, but gaze adds the approach side. Given both, GRAZE keeps the prompt's part accuracy and follows gaze.

papers.title_en: ReuseMem: One Memory, Multiple Goals in Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Yoonseok Kang, Dayeon Jung, Seunghoon Jeon, Wonjib Kim, Dongchul Park
papers.evidence: 面向机器人多目标物体操作的视觉记忆与动作方法
papers.tldr: 机器人与人协作时，观察到的经历可能要在未来响应不同操控请求；同一视觉记录既可能用于识别物体，也可能用于将物体放回原位。ReuseMem记录不依赖未来目标的视觉特征，针对请求检索互补证据，再结合当前场景生成动作。检索依据是候选证据对不同当前状态下专家动作预测的支持程度；在基准任务中，联合目标完成率较均匀记忆提高24.5个百分点。实验显示，一份记录可复用于多种后续请求，为场景变化中的机器人操控提供通用记忆方案。
papers.abstract_en: Robots that work alongside people should be able to use what they have seen when new requests arise. The same experience may later support identifying an object or returning it to its original location, although these uses were unknown during observation. ReuseMem learns to use one visual memory for multiple later manipulation goals. It records visual features independently of future goals, retrieves complementary evidence for each request, and combines it with the current scene through a lightweight action interface. Retrieval is supervised by how well candidate evidence supports expert-action prediction across different current states, linking memory selection to its use in manipulation. Repeated visual features are stored once, and memory computations that remain unchanged during action generation are reused. Experiments on four simulation tasks and two physical scenarios demonstrate reuse of a common recording across different requests. With matched action adaptation, ReuseMem improves joint goal completion on the benchmark tasks by 24.5 percentage points over uniform memory. These findings show that one memory can support multiple later manipulation goals as the scene changes.

papers.title_en: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
papers.authors: Arda Cinar Demirtas, Pablo Varela Bernal, Marc Pollefeys, Sunghwan Hong
papers.evidence: 单次前向传播预测多视图深度、相机位姿与点图
papers.tldr: 事件相机能在高速运动和弱光场景保留清晰结构，但带有稠密三维真值的事件数据稀缺，制约了多视角三维感知。Déjà-Events 通过配对图像与事件记录，从冻结的 Déjà View 蒸馏事件模型，无需深度或位姿标注。它以稀疏性感知自适应门控适配不同事件密度，并一次预测深度、相机位姿和点图。仅用模拟数据训练后，模型在 EventScape、MVSEC 和 DSEC 上表现突出；DSEC 深度误差为最强基线的一半，参数量约为其十分之一，为低成本事件三维感知提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.

papers.title_en: HospitalBench: Diagnosing Where and Why Embodied Agents Fail on Long Hospital Task Chains
papers.authors: Gaytri Jena, Kapil Wanaskar, Aman Chadha, Vasu Sharma, Vinija Jain, Amitava Das
papers.evidence: 在仿真环境中评测具身智能体的连续任务执行
papers.tldr: 长链医院任务的终点成败难揭示具身智能体在哪一步、因何失败；并列子任务评测也难检验前序状态对后续行动的影响。HospitalBench在Isaac Sim设置十项医院杂务，每项含两步热身和连续仿真的五个计分子任务，以技能级工具驱动视觉语言智能体，并记录断链、失败后的行为与定位漂移。当前仅完成计划60次中的15次运行，2次通过全部五项；189次失败调用中，168次之后尝试了不同调用，111次后续调用成功。基准还提供脚本机器人可解性验证、评测工具和轨迹，支持细粒度诊断；这些结果仍属初步报告。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied tasks fail in ways that end-task success cannot see. HospitalBench is a diagnostic benchmark of ten hospital chores in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each two unscored warm-up steps followed by a causal chain of five scored sub-tasks in one continuous simulation: the state one step leaves (an object pose, a choice, a fact seen once) determines what the next step must do, unlike benchmarks that place sub-tasks side by side. Vision-language agents act through skill-level tools from camera images. A scripted robot that makes only the calls a model gets is the solvability check of a chore. From each trajectory the benchmark reads where a chain breaks, what the agent did after a failed call, and how far its own position estimate drifts from the true one. This version reports first results only: 15 of 60 planned runs (three models at high effort, one run each on chores T1 and T10 from both start states and T3 from one), with scripted-robot proofs on three of the ten chores. Of the 15 runs, 2 passed all five sub-tasks. Runs still going after sub-tasks 1 to 5 were 15, 8, 4, 2, 2. Of 189 failed calls, 168 were followed by a different call and 111 by a call that did not fail. These are first results and not a full benchmark. We will release the scenes, task chains, scripted robot, evaluation harness and trajectories.

papers.title_en: VLN-Flash: Parallel Action Decoding with Adaptive Execution for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Ruizhe Xie, Honghua Chen, Binglin Wang, Tong Guo, Xu Tang, Puti Yan, Shaoxiong Cai
papers.evidence: 面向机器人视觉语言导航的并行动作解码
papers.tldr: 视觉语言导航策略逐步自回归预测动作时，连续依赖会使机器人等待，影响实时执行。VLN-Flash利用离散动作词表，在一次前向计算中并行评估完整短期动作前缀树，并依据贪心前缀与最强替代项的分差，自适应决定执行步数。匹配输入下，Uni-NaVid和StreamVLN解码近三倍提速；在R2R-CE、RxR-CE上成功率及路径加权成功率提升，成功率最高增加2.7个百分点。实机GO2导航成功提升，扣除网络传输后动作间等待减少约160毫秒，体现了无需训练即可兼顾效率与导航效果的价值。
papers.abstract_en: When a vision-and-language navigation policy generates an action sequence autoregressively, the robot waits for a chain of dependent predictions. A small discrete action vocabulary makes it possible to score all short-horizon plans in parallel. We introduce VLN-Flash, a training-free decoder that evaluates the complete action-prefix tree in a single forward pass. Branch-specific attention and matched token positions preserve the original policy's conditional action distribution for each prefix in exact arithmetic. We use the score margin between the stepwise-greedy prefix and its strongest alternative at each depth to decide how many actions to execute. The robot then executes the plan with the highest joint score at the chosen depth before observing again. On matched inputs, VLN-Flash achieves a nearly $3\times$ speedup in action decoding over native autoregression on Uni-NaVid and StreamVLN. Compared with the native autoregressive decoders, it improves success rate and success weighted by path length (SPL) on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, with success gains up to 2.7 percentage points. On a Unitree GO2, VLN-Flash improves navigation success and cuts the mean wait between actions by about 160 ms after subtracting network transmission time.

papers.title_en: Depth-Aware Path Planning and Collision Avoidance for Robotic Nursing Assistants Using Real-Time 3D Vision
papers.authors: Peeyush Thakur, Dharmendra Sharma, Archit Sharma, Sandeep Gupta, Anuj Nandanwar, Laxmidhar Behera
papers.evidence: 机器人结合RGB-D深度感知进行路径规划与避障
papers.tldr: 护理辅助机器人需要在病房等杂乱环境中安全移动，但激光雷达可能漏检透明或低矮障碍，视觉感知也容易受噪声和遮挡影响。论文提出深度感知导航框架，融合RGB-D深度信息、规则式避障和NavfnROS全局路径规划，并在搭载机械臂的Husky A200上实现分层感知与实时控制。仿真结果显示，相比单传感器基线，导航成功率最高提升40%，最小间距改善35%；实机实验进一步验证了计算效率和安全性，为护理机器人在复杂环境中的自主导航提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a depth-aware path planning and collision avoidance framework for the safe navigation of robotic nursing assistants in cluttered environments with low-height obstacles. Conventional LiDAR-based navigation systems, while accurate for mapping and localization, fail to detect transparent or low-height obstacles, whereas vision-based systems are prone to noise and occlusion. The proposed framework integrates RGB-D depth sensing, rule-based obstacle avoidance, and the NavfnROS global path planner to drive the robot from an initial point to a goal point. The proposed approach is implemented on the Husky A200 robot, equipped with a Kinova Gen3 arm, to form a complete setup for a robotic nursing assistant. This system features a multi-layer architecture for global planning, perception fusion, and real-time control in the ROS-Gazebo environment. Experimental evaluations in a simulated cluttered environment demonstrate up to 40\% higher success rate and 35\% improvement in minimum clearance compared with single-sensor baselines. Furthermore, real-world experimental results validate the proposed approach as a computationally efficient and safety-aware navigation solution for autonomous healthcare robots.

papers.title_en: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
papers.authors: Chongyu Fan, Gaowen Liu, Ramana Rao Kompella, Jason Corso, Sijia Liu
papers.evidence: 通过预测动作引起的视觉变化，改进具身世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 现有世界动作模型通常监督完整未来观测，但动作片段内画面变化有限，训练容易偏向复制静态背景，且依赖大型生成模型，妨碍低成本闭环部署。ResWAM改为在冻结DINOv3特征空间预测当前到未来的残差，并以轻量双分支DiT联合学习动作与场景变化。无额外机器人预训练时，它在LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0和RoboDojo取得强劲成绩，真实机器人开放、放置和堆叠任务平均成功率达80%，延迟仅92.7毫秒。结果表明，直接学习变化可兼顾策略性能与计算效率。
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $π_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.

papers.title_en: Toward Planning Representations That Separate Task Structure from Visual Content
papers.authors: Aarav Srivastava, Vishwas Sathish, Rajesh P. N. Rao
papers.evidence: 评估智能体在视觉变化下的物体目标导航
papers.tldr: 物体目标导航要求智能体在视觉变化中保留空间几何与目标物体身份，但既有泛化评估常同时改变多个因素，难以解释性能下降。本研究在 ProcTHOR 房屋中固定布局、物体位置、目标和起点，逐项及组合改变表面材质、杂物与光照，并比较多类强化学习及冻结视觉特征方法。结果显示，表面材质是成功率变化的主要来源，杂物和光照影响较小；图像统计变化幅度也不能可靠预测表现，单改目标物外观就可能显著损害端到端智能体。基于冻结 DINOv2 特征进行模型式规划，在全因素变化下成功率最高，为0.83，但仍受表面外观影响。研究指出，规划表示需要将不变的空间任务结构与外观内容分离。
papers.abstract_en: Effective planning requires representations that preserve task-relevant geometry and object identity while ignoring visual variation that does not alter the task. Existing evaluations of visual generalization often change several factors simultaneously, making the source of a failure difficult to identify. We introduce a controlled evaluation of object-goal navigation (ObjectNav), the task of reaching an instance of a named object category, in procedurally generated ProcTHOR houses. Training and evaluation houses share floor plans, object locations, goals, and start states, while visual factors are changed individually or in combination. Across model-free reinforcement learning (RL), model-based RL, and agents using frozen pretrained visual representations, our results show that appearance changes impair navigation, but their effects differ sharply by factor. Surface material changes account for most of the average change in success, whereas clutter and lighting have little effect. The magnitude of a global image statistics shift does not reliably predict performance: changing only the goal object's appearance can substantially impair an end-to-end agent despite a small image-level change. We found that a model based agent that plans over frozen features from the pretrained DINOv2 image encoder achieves the highest success (0.83) under the full shift, but remains sensitive to surface appearance. Our experiments reveal an important requirement for planning representations: they must separate invariant spatial task structure from appearance.

papers.title_en: SplatFlow3D: Learning Scene Flow via 3D Motion Feature Splatting
papers.authors: Bo Wang, Dekang Zhu, Jian Li, Zhipeng Meng, Bo Wang, Dewen Hu
papers.evidence: 通过层级三维运动特征与多帧融合估计场景流
papers.tldr: 场景流估计依赖相邻帧，遮挡会造成运动信息缺失，而多帧时序连续性有望补足这一问题。论文先提出轻量双帧骨干SimpleFlow3D，以分层三维运动特征将图像平面的稠密信息与深度维度的稀疏信息先解耦、后耦合。再通过权重共享框架，将前一帧运动特征投射到当前估计，并用伪输入统一首帧与后续帧推理。组合模型SplatFlow3D在KITTI与Spring均居已发表及提交方法首位，同时改善遮挡、非刚性运动估计和真实场景泛化，参数量也较现有方法更少。
papers.abstract_en: Considering the motion continuity and stability of 3D objects over short inter-frame intervals, introducing multi-frame settings in scene flow estimation can potentially address occlusion. In this paper, we propose a two-frame backbone, SimpleFlow3D, which integrates dense information from the image plane and sparse information from the depth dimension in a decoupling-followed-by-coupling manner by hierarchically constructing the 3D motion feature. SimpleFlow3D achieves SOTA results with minimal parameters. We also propose a weight-sharing multi-frame framework to splat the previous 3D motion feature to the current estimation process. The framework unifies the first and non-first frame inference by constructing pseudo inputs. After combining the proposed framework and backbone, the newly born multi-frame method SplatFlow3D further advances the state of the art. It achieves lower errors than the two-frame backbone, with fewer parameters than current methods. On both KITTI and Spring, SplatFlow3D ranked 1st over all published and submitted methods. Experiments show that SplatFlow3D improves occlusion handling, non-rigid motion estimation, and generalization to real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/SplatFlow3D.

papers.title_en: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
papers.authors: Jiajun Sun, Zeyu Zhang, Zeyu Ren, Guangfeng Jiang, Yang Zhao, Hao Tang
papers.evidence: 将驾驶场景视频提升为时序三维高斯世界模型
papers.tldr: 驾驶世界模型常用六个针孔相机分别生成视频，光心分离且视野重叠有限，因此需要额外学习跨视角一致性。PanDWM将六路画面拼成单幅360°全景带，以布局为条件，由因果学生分窗、四步生成，并经因果教师蒸馏及自身滚动轨迹训练；随后沿像素对应射线解码三维高斯，融合邻帧静态高斯构成四维场景。在nuScenes全景评测中，它较多相机基线取得更低FID和FVD且快8至46倍；相较50步教师，FID持平、FVD降低22%至25%。该设计以图像连续性替代跨视角对齐，为高效、连贯的全景驾驶世界建模提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent. We present PanDWM, which stitches them into one $360^\circ$ panoramic band. Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. Conditioned on layouts, a causal student generates the band window by window in four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own rollouts. A feed-forward decoder lifts each frame along these rays into 3D Gaussians, and static Gaussians from neighbouring frames complete them into 4D scenes. On nuScenes, scored in one stitched $360^\circ$ view, PanDWM has lower FID and FVD than the multi-camera baselines at $8$-$46\times$ their speed, and keeps its 50-step teacher's FID while lowering FVD by 22-25%.

papers.title_en: CRAFT: A Robot-Agent Harness with Scope-Aware Adaptation
papers.authors: Peng Zhang, Jiawen Wang, Cheng Xue, Jochen Renz
papers.evidence: 机器人依据人类反馈学习物体放置要求
papers.tldr: 机器人即使具备物体移动技能，也未必知道物品应放在哪里；面对人的纠正，关键是判断要求只针对当前情境，还是代表更广泛规则。CRAFT将物理执行是否成功与是否符合要求分开记录，并以范围阶梯结合近似情境记忆、显式规则和规则之外的要求学习器，按过往反馈预测表现加权。受控实验中，它比仅记忆纠正获得更高效用；相机仿真中提问更少，但部分持久记忆语言模型犯错更少、要求改变后成功率更高。研究说明局部记忆与通用规则应结合，也指出变化要求下的可靠适应仍未解决，且证据仅来自模拟。
papers.abstract_en: A robot may know how to move an object yet still need to learn where it belongs. When a person rejects a placement, the robot must decide whether the correction applies only to that situation or expresses a broader rule. We study this problem in CRAFT (Contextual Requirement Adaptation with Frozen Tools), a framework for learning local requirements without retraining robot skills. It records physical success separately from whether an action meets the requirement. Our scope ladder uses memory when an action has already been judged in a nearly identical situation. Elsewhere, it combines memory, explicit rules and a learner for requirements beyond those rules, weighting their predictions by how well they predicted earlier feedback. Controlled studies show gains over correction memory alone in utility, which rewards acceptable actions and charges for mistakes and questions. In camera-grounded robot simulations, the ladder asks fewer questions than language-model agents with persistent memory, but some of those agents take fewer wrong actions and succeed more often after requirements change. All execution failures and timeouts remain in the evaluation. These results support combining specific memories with broader rules, while leaving reliable adaptation to changing requirements unresolved. All evidence comes from simulation with generated requirements and simulated feedback.

papers.title_en: XMimic and XSoma: Learning Humanoid Motion Tracking and Locomotion in Under a Minute
papers.authors: Nico Bohlinger, Jan Peters
papers.evidence: 人形机器人运动学习与世界模型训练
papers.tldr: 人形机器人动作追踪和崎岖地形行走的训练，常受连续小型 GPU 操作拖累，难以发挥多卡算力。XMimic 与 XSoma 基于 SuperMimic 世界模型和解析梯度优化，并用 JAX 编译完整训练循环、并行执行每轮步骤。四张 H100 上，XMimic 仅用 0.86 分钟追踪 40 段 LAFAN1 动作；XSoma 用 0.77 分钟达到既定行走测试目标，比 FastSAC 快 12.3 倍且环境步数仅为八分之一。结果显示，精简训练链并扩大并行度，可将 humanoid 技能学习压缩至一分钟以内。
papers.abstract_en: We present XMimic and XSoma, which learn humanoid motion tracking and locomotion on rough terrain in under a minute of training. Both follow SuperMimic, which learns a world model of the robot and optimizes the policy with analytic gradients through short rollouts imagined in this model. Existing implementations of this method do not make use of larger GPUs, as every training iteration is a long chain of small GPU operations that run one after another. XMimic and XSoma therefore shorten this chain and run the steps of every iteration at the same time on up to four GPUs. We compile the complete training loop with JAX, including the MuJoCo Warp simulator. For locomotion, XSoma leaves only the dynamics of the robot to the world model and computes everything else exactly, including the terrain height under the feet. It learns with a horizon of one second and without a critic. On four H100 GPUs, XMimic learns to track all 40 LAFAN1 clips with the Unitree G1 in 0.86 minutes, 3.7 times faster than BlinkMimic on one GPU. XSoma reaches the tracking target that Holosoma's tests set for FastSAC in 0.77 minutes, 12.3 times faster than FastSAC on one GPU, while needing only an eighth of its environment steps.

papers.title_en: Pointillist Maize: 3D Reconstruction of Field-Grown Maize Using RGB UAV Imagery
papers.authors: Dewi Endah Kharismawati, Toni Kazic
papers.evidence: 从无人机影像通过运动恢复结构和多视图立体重建三维几何
papers.tldr: 田间玉米叶片、茎秆等细长柔性器官易遮挡且会随风或采集扰动而移动，使无人机影像的三维重建面临挑战。研究采用消费级无人机RGB视频和COLMAP，评估航线与抽帧率对重建结果的影响。等帧数比较显示，单圈航线获得更多点并使点云更集中；密植场景中，增加蛇形航线或提高抽帧率可显著减少可见空洞，但额外观测也会加剧运动造成的点云离散。研究证明玉米器官可被辨认，为田间三维表型采集提供参考，同时指出定量应用仍需独立几何验证。
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional reconstruction can extend field phenotyping to individual maize organs, but thin, flexible, occluding structures and plant movement complicate reconstruction. We evaluated whether consumer-grade UAV RGB video processed with Structure from Motion and multi-view stereo could recover recognizable field-grown maize structures, and examined the effects of acquisition trajectories and frame sampling. COLMAP reconstructions preserved recognizable leaves, stems, tassel branches, ears, silks, and brace roots. For an equal-frame comparison, we reconstructed one plant from two sets of 295 frames from the same video: a single orbit sampled at 5 frames/second and three orbits at different altitudes (ribbon skirt) sampled at 2 frames/second. After ground removal, the reconstructions contained 520,601 and 375,318 points, respectively. The single orbit yielded greater point concentration within plant structures and fewer visible gaps, while the ribbon skirt yielded fewer scattered points and slightly lower proportions of isolated points. In densely planted nursery rows, visible voids occupied 17.57% of the rendered scene with one orbit at 1 frame/second, decreasing to 5.07% with additional serpentine passes and 2.68% when the original orbit was sampled at 3 frames/second. Additional observations also increased point dispersion associated with plant movement. A curlicue trajectory tested in a different field in 2024 produced distinguishable individual plants without visible duplicated structures, although substantial voids remained, mainly on the soil surface. These results demonstrate the feasibility of recovering recognizable maize organs from consumer UAV imagery and reveal trade-offs between acquisition strategies, reconstruction completeness, and point dispersion. Independent geometric validation is still needed before quantitative phenotyping.

papers.title_en: Cooperative Gradient Estimation for Multi-Robot Source Seeking with Heteroskedastic Measurements
papers.authors: Alessandro Renzaglia, Lara Briñón-Arranz
papers.evidence: 协作移动机器人通过测量与信息共享执行源定位
papers.tldr: 三维标量场源定位要求机器人依据局部强度测量估计空间梯度，但不同机器人传感精度不一，噪声方差异质会削弱估计可靠性。本文让异构机器人协作采样，在球面上按传感噪声方差设计加权质心 Voronoi 编队，并以加权最小二乘估计编队中心梯度。作者推导梯度估计协方差及球面编队的方差下界，证明所提构造渐近满足达到下界的条件，仿真也显示其寻源有效并能应对机器人失效。该框架将异质性同时纳入布阵与估计，为稳健寻源和在线重构提供近最优方案。
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel approach for localizing the source of a three-dimensional scalar field using a team of heterogeneous cooperative mobile robots. Each robot measures the field intensity at its location and shares the information within the team. Measurement noise is explicitly considered, and heterogeneity arises from robot-dependent sensing accuracies, leading to heteroskedastic data. The proposed framework combines a weighted centroidal Voronoi tessellation-based formation strategy, defined on a spherical surface and parameterized by sensor noise variances, with a Weighted Least Squares estimator to compute the field gradient at the formation center. By explicitly accounting for sensor heterogeneity in both formation design and estimation, the method achieves robust gradient estimation under noisy measurements. In particular, we show analytically that this construction is nearly optimal. The covariance of the gradient estimate is derived in closed form, providing a lower bound on the attainable estimation variance for any formation on the sphere, and the proposed tessellation is shown to asymptotically satisfy the conditions under which this bound is attained. The estimated gradient is then exploited within a gradient-ascent strategy to guide the team toward the source location. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach compared to alternative strategies and highlight its intrinsic ability to reconfigure online in response to robot failures, thereby enhancing its adaptability.

papers.title_en: Learning Spatially Aware Audio-Visual Features from Videos with Mono Audio
papers.authors: Mengyu Yang, You Zhang, Vishnu Raj, Olha Townsend, James Hays, Andrea Fanelli, Gautam Bhattacharya
papers.evidence: 联合音频视觉进行空间推理，涉及环境空间感知
papers.tldr: 音视理解既要识别声音语义，也要判断声源的空间位置与运动，但空间模型受真实数据稀缺限制，语义模型又难以完整表达空间特征。论文提出联合处理双耳音频与视觉的模型，并从单声道视频自动定位声源、估计相对三维轨迹、渲染双耳音频，进而扩展 VGGSound 训练数据。实验表明，该模型提升了空间推理表现与泛化能力，同时在语义任务上仍具竞争力。工作为兼顾语义和空间理解提供了可扩展的数据构建方案与模型路径。
papers.abstract_en: Comprehensive audio-visual perception requires both semantic and spatial reasoning. Existing spatial models suffer from poor generalization due to data scarcity, while semantic-only models fail to capture spatial characteristics completely. We introduce a model capable of jointly reasoning over binaural audio and vision on semantic and spatial tasks with improved generalization. To overcome the shortage in real-world data, we develop an automatic pipeline that localizes the sound source in a video, estimates its relative 3D trajectory, and renders binaural audio. We then use this to spatialize VGGSound, allowing us to train at a much larger scale. We demonstrate improved performance and generalization on spatial reasoning tasks while still remaining competitive on semantic tasks compared to semantic-only models.

papers.title_en: AGPF: Dynamic Source Selection for Feature Pyramid Fusion
papers.authors: Xu Yang, Gady Agam
papers.evidence: 动态融合特征金字塔的多尺度信息，与多尺度场景解析方法相关
papers.tldr: 特征金字塔为密集预测提供多尺度特征，但固定的层间融合未能回答每个输出位置应从哪些尺度获取信息。研究发现，最细网格位置约75%的注意力落在粗两级特征上，且目标越大，关注越偏向粗尺度。AGPF保留原有输出网格，以对齐图像坐标的多尺度记忆支持各位置动态选择上下文来源。在COCO上，它提升全部19种检测与7种实例分割配置，单个融合块令Cascade Mask R-CNN框AP和掩码AP分别提高1.7与2.3，并可迁移至语义及全景分割。
papers.abstract_en: Feature pyramids provide dense predictors with features at several spatial resolutions. However, it remains largely unexplored which pyramid levels each output location should aggregate information from. We investigate this question by allowing each output location to attend to features from every pyramid level and measuring how attention is distributed across scales. Surprisingly, locations on the finest output grid allocate approximately 75\% of their attention to features two levels coarser, rather than to the current or adjacent levels. Even on the same output grid, the balance shifts toward coarser features as object size increases.   These observations motivate Asymmetric Global Pyramid Fusion (AGPF), a neck that preserves the original output grids while allowing each location to dynamically select its contextual sources across scales. Each location interacts with a multiscale memory whose features are aligned in image coordinates, enabling flexible cross-scale aggregation without altering prediction resolutions. Compared with FPN, AGPF improves all 19 object detection and all seven instance segmentation configurations evaluated on COCO. A single fusion block improves Cascade Mask R-CNN by 1.7 box AP and 2.3 mask AP, and the gains consistently transfer to semantic and panoptic segmentation.

papers.title_en: Latent World Modeling for Point-Cloud Video Pretraining
papers.authors: Zhuoyue Zhang, Jian Liu, Jihua Zhu, Ajmal Saeed Mian
papers.evidence: 研究点云视频的时空几何表示预训练
papers.tldr: 点云视频自监督预训练常用掩码建模，但目标点位置会泄露几何变化，双向可见帧还允许插值，使任务退化为补全而非预测。PointWM以严格早于目标的上下文预测未来帧特征与几何，查询时仅使用目标最后可见位置和时间戳，并引入无标注学习的潜在动作来表示过去无法确定的未来。在HOI4D动作分割中，基于P4Transformer的F1@50较从头训练提升24.9，严格因果推理下提升29.1。结果显示，潜在世界模型有望成为点云视频无泄漏预训练的新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Masked modeling is the dominant self-supervised paradigm for point-cloud videos. However, it leaks the information it is meant to predict, whether it reconstructs masked points as in MAE-style methods or predicts their latent features. Because point-cloud tokens are anchored at points sampled from each frame, querying a target at its own position reveals where its geometry has moved, in reconstruction and latent prediction alike. For latent predictors, random spatio-temporal masks introduce a further shortcut, as visible frames on both sides of each target allow interpolation rather than forecasting. The pretext task thus reduces to completion. Once the target positions are withheld, a masked latent predictor performs only slightly better than copying the last frame. To remove this leakage, we propose PointWM, a latent world model that turns completion into forecasting by predicting the features and geometry of future frames from strictly earlier context. Each target is queried only with its last-seen position and timestamp, while a latent action learned without annotations is meant to capture the part of the future that the past leaves undetermined. On HOI4D action segmentation with a P4Transformer backbone, PointWM improves F1@50 over training from scratch by 24.9 offline and 29.1 under strictly causal inference. These results show the promise of latent world models as a leakage-free pretraining paradigm for point-cloud videos.Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/InitalZ/PointWM.

papers.title_en: GeoReVis: Learning Selective Revision and Evidence Consolidation for Remote Sensing Segmentation
papers.authors: Ke An, Liang Chen, Yupei Wang
papers.evidence: 分割掩码的选择性修订与跨掩码证据整合
papers.tldr: 语言引导的遥感分割常因复杂空间关系出现定位错误；迭代修补虽能补回漏分区域，却可能破坏原本正确的掩码，不同候选中的有效证据也容易散落并被舍弃。GeoReVis以执行反馈学习有效修订动作，通过候选质量比较选择整体掩码，再保留多轮候选、拆分空间分歧区域，并结合完整指令与上下文重组互补证据。配套数据流程从模型自身输出构造多轮轨迹及修订、筛选和区域组合监督，评测协议ReVis-Eval则考察多轮修订与跨轮证据整合。实验在ReVis-Eval及五个遥感推理和指代分割基准上显示该方法有效，为减少修订退化、复用分散证据提供了统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recent methods try to inspect and revise masks to mitigate referential ambiguity and localization errors caused by complex spatial relations in language-guided remote sensing segmentation. However, these solutions often lead to Revision Degradation: revising missing regions may introduce errors into previously correct ones. Even a globally better mask can omit correct regions found in inferior masks. We term this Evidence Fragmentation: correct target evidence is scattered across imperfect masks. All masks generated by the model at this time are suboptimal. We propose GeoReVis, which unifies revision guided by execution feedback, Candidate Selection, and Cross-Mask Evidence Consolidation. It learns fine-grained revision from real actions that improve segmentation when executed and learns to select a better mask through quality comparisons between actual candidates, reducing the risk of degradation during revision. The selected whole mask can still discard useful regions. GeoReVis therefore retains all candidates across rounds, partitions their spatial disagreements into composable regions, and jointly reconstructs regions conditioned on the full instruction and context. This makes complementary and fragmentary evidence reusable regardless of its source candidate's overall quality, yielding improved segmentation. We further build a data pipeline to generate fine-grained multi-round segmentation trajectories and derive supervision for revision actions, candidate selection, and region composition from the model's own outputs, extending training beyond whole-mask IoU supervision. We also propose ReVis-Eval, a benchmark protocol evaluating multi-round revision and cross-round evidence consolidation accuracy. Experiments on ReVis-Eval and 5 benchmarks for remote sensing reasoning and referring segmentation demonstrate the effectiveness of GeoReVis.
